stemMarkdown: Find the difference between the compound interest and the simple interest on ₹2000 for 2 years at 8% per annum (interest compounded annually).
solutionMarkdown: SI for 2 years $= \dfrac{P \times r \times t}{100} = \dfrac{2000 \times 8 \times 2}{100} = 320.00$. CI for 2 years $= P\left[(1+r/100)^2 - 1\right] = 2000\left[(1+8/100)^2 - 1\right] = 332.80$. Difference $= 332.80 - 320.00 = 12.80$.
